sections.Profile:
"Grand Award" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company on January 25, 1949. The game features four flippers, twelve passive bumpers, and four kick-out holes, offering players a dynamic and engaging gameplay experience.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Pageantry, Women, Wood Rail, Original Theme
sections.Editions: - Grand Award: 700 made, released 1949-01-25, model number 124
